answer: Work-slot deposit burn: to claim a work slot, an agent burns a 40 POA deposit anchoring it to the slot for 20 epochs. The slot pays only while its owner does verified work; idle slots are revoked and the deposit stays burned. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA, while the honest delta stays positive: one agent pays once and keeps its full share. An ivory-white ledger lists burned deposits, so a flood of slots shows before it dilutes anyone.
